concerns.text: The 'UCI DROP' dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/ucinlp/drop/...) is a Reading Comprehension dataset (text-based QA). It does not natively provide a continuous target variable or numerical predictors suitable for OLS regression without extensive, non-trivial feature engineering (e.g., converting text to embeddings). The plan asserts it is 'Suitable for OLS if target is continuous' but fails to cite a specific numerical target or a verified numerical subset. This risks the pipeline failing the 'Real Data Only' constraint if no continuous target exists, or requiring synthetic derivation which is forbidden.

The 'UCI HAR' dataset (Human Activity Recognition) is primarily designed for classification (predicting activity class from sensor data). The plan assumes a 'continuous target' exists (e.g., 'TotalSpent' equivalent). If the only target is categorical (activity label), the dataset is inappropriate for OLS regression stability analysis. The plan must cite a specific continuous variable within the dataset or replace the dataset with one guaranteed to have a continuous target (e.g., a housing price or energy consumption dataset).
